litigation-disputes.name: Litigation & Disputes
litigation-disputes.description: Civil, criminal, family and consumer disputes argued before trial courts, tribunals and the High Court, with settlement pursued wherever it serves you.

constitutional-appellate.name: Constitutional & Appellate
constitutional-appellate.description: Writ petitions, PILs, constitutional questions, appeals, revisions and tribunal matters before the High Court and specialised forums.

corporate-commercial.name: Corporate & Commercial
corporate-commercial.description: Company, commercial, banking, recovery, cyber and intellectual-property matters for businesses, promoters and professionals.

property-advisory.name: Property, Registration & Advisory
property-advisory.description: Property and land matters, employment law, registrations, succession, and careful drafting of contracts, opinions and documents.

civil-litigation.name: ᱥᱮᱨᱩᱧ ᱠᱟᱪᱟᱨ
civil-litigation.summary: ᱠᱟᱜᱟᱬ, ᱢᱟᱱᱚᱠ, ᱠᱟᱦᱟᱬ ᱠᱚ ᱱᱤᱠᱚᱞ ᱛᱤᱭᱟᱨ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱛᱮ।
civil-litigation.description: ᱟᱢ ᱚᱱᱩᱠᱚᱞ ᱟᱨ ᱵᱟᱥᱤ ᱛᱮ ᱥᱮᱨᱩᱧ ᱠᱟᱦᱟᱬ — ᱛᱟᱠᱟ ᱜᱟᱨ, ᱦᱮᱠᱨ, ᱦᱩᱠᱩᱢ, ᱵᱷᱤᱞᱤ ᱠᱨᱤᱭᱟ ᱟᱨ ᱚᱯᱤᱞ। ᱨᱟᱲ ᱠᱟᱦᱟᱬ ᱠᱷᱚᱠᱢᱟ ᱪᱷᱮᱛᱨᱚ ᱛᱮ, ᱞᱟᱠᱟ ᱛᱚᱦᱲᱚ, ᱞᱟᱲᱤᱧ ᱫᱟᱲᱮ ᱟᱨ ᱡᱚᱛᱠ ᱩᱭᱤᱧ।
bullets: ᱠᱟᱪᱟᱨ ᱜᱟᱬ ᱦᱟᱴᱤ ᱨᱚᱫ ᱟᱨ ᱡᱩᱜ ᱛᱮ ᱭᱟᱠᱟ
ᱠᱟᱜᱟᱬ, ᱞᱟᱠᱩᱢ, ᱛᱷᱚᱱᱟ ᱟᱨ ᱚᱯᱤᱞ ᱠᱚ
ᱛᱟᱲᱤᱧ ᱥᱚᱨᱚᱜ: ᱢᱟᱱᱚᱠ, ᱟᱛᱮ ᱟᱨ ᱛᱚᱦᱲᱚ ᱛᱟᱞᱟ
ᱠᱷᱟᱨᱟᱪ ᱟᱨ ᱱᱟᱦᱟᱜ ᱠᱚᱨ ᱟᱜᱣ
ᱦᱟᱠᱩᱠᱢ ᱯᱟᱞᱟᱱ ᱤᱡᱨᱟ ᱠᱚ ᱪᱦᱬᱤ

criminal-litigation.name: ᱠᱟᱨᱟᱜ ᱠᱟᱪᱟᱨ
criminal-litigation.summary: ᱡᱩᱦᱚ, ᱠᱟᱪᱟᱨ ᱚᱦ ᱟᱨ ᱦᱩᱠᱟᱢ ᱟᱞᱮᱩ ᱛᱟᱞᱟ, ᱫᱟᱯᱛᱟ ᱟᱨ ᱞᱞᱚᱠ।
criminal-litigation.description: ᱯᱩᱸᱞᱤ ᱞᱚᱠᱰᱟ ᱦᱟᱨᱩ ᱠᱷᱩᱱ ᱠᱟᱞ ᱦᱟᱠᱩᱠᱢ ᱥᱟᱦᱟ, ᱟᱢ ᱠᱞᱤᱧᱜ ᱨᱮ ᱪᱦᱬᱨᱟᱛ — ᱡᱩᱦᱚ ᱟᱨ ᱞᱞᱚᱠ ᱠᱷᱟᱵᱤ, ᱳᱦ ᱥᱚᱣᱟᱞ, ᱠᱟᱪᱟᱨ ᱚᱦ ᱟᱨ ᱚᱯᱤᱞ — ᱟᱨ ᱥᱟᱦᱤ ᱞᱟᱡᱤ ᱤ ᱯᱤ ᱠᱚ।
bullets: ᱡᱩᱦᱚ ᱟᱨ ᱞᱞᱚᱠ ᱴᱷᱚᱱᱟ ᱢᱟᱨᱩᱛ ᱛᱮ
ᱞᱚᱠᱰᱟ, FIR ᱟᱨ ᱪᱟᱝᱞᱚ ᱕ᱨᱤ ᱛᱮ ᱠᱟᱦᱟ
ᱠᱟᱪᱟᱨ ᱚᱦ ᱞᱠᱟ ᱨᱟᱲ ᱚᱠᱛᱚ
ᱳᱦ ᱥᱚᱣᱟᱞ ᱟᱨ ᱠᱟᱨᱟᱜ ᱚᱯᱤᱞ ᱱᱟᱦᱟᱜ ᱠᱚᱨ ᱡᱩᱲ
ᱦᱩᱠᱟᱢ ᱜᱚᱞᱟ ᱟᱨ ᱥᱟᱦᱤ ᱪᱦᱬᱨᱟᱛ ᱞᱟᱡᱤ ᱞᱟ

bail-anticipatory-bail-criminal-appeals.name: Bail, Anticipatory Bail & Criminal Appeals
bail-anticipatory-bail-criminal-appeals.summary: Urgent bail applications and appeals argued on priority.
bail-anticipatory-bail-criminal-appeals.description: Liberty matters cannot wait. We move regular and anticipatory bail applications on priority, and pursue criminal appeals and revisions before the Sessions Court and High Court with focused, well-prepared arguments.
bullets: Anticipatory bail before Sessions Court and High Court
Regular bail and cancellation-of-bail matters
Urgent mentioning and priority listing where needed
Criminal appeals and revisions against conviction or sentence
Suspension of sentence pending appeal

cheque-bounce-cases.name: ᱪᱮᱠ ᱫᱟᱣᱱᱞᱳᱰ ᱠᱟᱦᱟᱬ
cheque-bounce-cases.summary: Section 138 ᱯᱳᱭᱤ ᱟᱨ ᱞᱮᱞᱟᱨ, ᱦᱟᱠᱩᱠᱢ ᱠᱷᱩᱱ।
cheque-bounce-cases.description: ᱚᱭᱱ ᱪᱮᱠ ᱢᱚᱢ ᱴᱟᱭᱤᱧ ᱨᱮᱭ। ᱟᱢ ᱩᱟᱨ ᱞᱚᱠᱰᱟ ᱦᱠᱟᱢ, ᱞᱮᱞᱟᱨ ᱠᱥᱮ Section 138 ᱥᱟᱦᱟ, ᱟᱨ ᱞᱞᱚᱠ ᱠᱩᱜ ᱞᱟᱰ ᱛᱟᱦᱮ।
bullets: ᱞᱟᱜᱪ ᱟᱠᱟᱞ ᱱᱤᱢᱚᱲᱳ ᱨᱮ
Section 138 ᱥᱟᱦᱟ ᱞᱮᱞᱟᱨ ᱟᱨ ᱪᱚᱥᱞᱟ
ᱚᱠᱠᱭᱩᱡᱤᱫ ᱴᱨᱟᱥᱟ ᱱᱤᱛᱤ
ᱥᱤᱜᱪᱲᱚ ᱞᱚᱠᱰᱟ ᱟᱨ ᱠᱯᱟᱯ
ᱡᱷᱭᱟ ᱣᱮᱞ ᱞᱟᱡᱤ ᱞᱟ

family-matrimonial-disputes.name: Family & Matrimonial Disputes
family-matrimonial-disputes.summary: Divorce, maintenance and custody handled sensitively and firmly.
family-matrimonial-disputes.description: Family disputes call for both compassion and precision. We advise on mutual-consent and contested divorce, maintenance, domestic-violence proceedings and child custody — always seeking the outcome that protects your future and your children.
bullets: Mutual-consent divorce with minimum conflict
Contested divorce petitions and defence
Maintenance and alimony claims under applicable laws
Child custody and visitation arrangements
Protection orders in domestic-violence proceedings

consumer-protection-cases.name: Consumer Protection Cases
consumer-protection-cases.summary: Claims against defective goods and deficient services before consumer forums.
consumer-protection-cases.description: We help consumers seek redressal for defective products, deficiency in service, unfair trade practices and insurance or builder disputes before the District, State and National Consumer Commissions.
bullets: Drafting and filing of consumer complaints
Builder-delay and real-estate claims
Insurance claim rejection disputes
Medical negligence and service-deficiency claims
Enforcement of consumer forum orders

arbitration-mediation.name: Arbitration & Mediation
arbitration-mediation.summary: Faster, private resolution of commercial and contractual disputes.
arbitration-mediation.description: For commercial and contractual disputes, arbitration and mediation often deliver a faster, more private outcome than court. We draft arbitration clauses, represent parties through the reference and pursue negotiated settlements.
bullets: Drafting and review of arbitration and dispute clauses
Representation in domestic arbitration proceedings
Section 9 and Section 17 interim relief applications
Enforcement and challenge of arbitral awards
Mediation and structured settlement negotiation

labour-industrial-matters.name: Labour & Industrial Matters
labour-industrial-matters.summary: Wages, gratuity, termination and industrial disputes for workers and employers.
labour-industrial-matters.description: We act for workmen, employees and employers in industrial and labour disputes — unpaid wages, gratuity and provident fund, termination and retrenchment, and compensation claims — before Labour Courts, Industrial Tribunals and the appropriate authorities.
bullets: Industrial disputes, conciliation and reference proceedings
Recovery of wages, gratuity, bonus and provident-fund dues
Termination, retrenchment and reinstatement claims
Workmen's compensation and employee benefit disputes
Domestic inquiries, standing orders and compliance support

writ-petitions.name: Writ Petitions
writ-petitions.summary: Enforcing your rights against the State before the High Court.
writ-petitions.description: When a public authority acts unfairly or illegally, a writ petition before the High Court is often the fastest remedy. We file petitions for mandamus, certiorari, prohibition and habeas corpus, challenging arbitrary orders and inaction.
bullets: Writs against arbitrary or illegal State action
Service, admission, tender and regulatory grievances
Quashing of adverse administrative orders
Stay and interim directions on urgent basis
Contempt petitions to enforce compliance

constitutional-law.name: Constitutional Law
constitutional-law.summary: Advice and advocacy on fundamental rights and constitutional questions.
constitutional-law.description: We advise and appear on constitutional questions — fundamental-rights violations, challenges to the vires of statutes and rules, and matters involving the powers of public authorities before the High Court.
bullets: Fundamental-rights enforcement and advice
Challenges to the validity of statutes and rules
Public-authority jurisdiction and powers questions
Strategic advice on constitutional remedies
Representation in constitutional matters before the High Court

public-interest-litigation.name: Public Interest Litigations (PIL)
public-interest-litigation.summary: Litigating matters of genuine public concern responsibly.
public-interest-litigation.description: A PIL lets a citizen raise a genuine matter of public concern before the High Court. We assess locus and public interest, prepare a well-documented petition, and pursue it responsibly through to relief.
bullets: Assessment of locus standi and genuine public interest
Fact and document gathering for a strong petition
Drafting and filing of the PIL
Representation and follow-up before the High Court
Monitoring compliance with the Court's directions

high-court-appeals-revisions.name: High Court Appeals & Revisions
high-court-appeals-revisions.summary: Challenging adverse orders through appeal and revision.
high-court-appeals-revisions.description: An adverse order is rarely the end of the road. We evaluate the prospects of appeal and revision, identify the strongest grounds, and argue civil and criminal appeals and revisions before the High Court.
bullets: Honest appraisal of appellate prospects
Identification of the strongest grounds of challenge
Civil and criminal appeals before the High Court
Revision petitions against lower-court orders
Stay of the impugned order pending appeal

tribunal-matters.name: Tribunal Matters (CAT, NCLT, DRT, DRAT, AFT)
tribunal-matters.summary: Specialised advocacy before India's key tribunals.
tribunal-matters.description: Much of today's litigation happens before specialised tribunals. We appear before the CAT, NCLT, DRT, DRAT and AFT — handling service, company, debt-recovery and armed-forces matters with forum-specific expertise.
bullets: Service matters before the CAT
Company and insolvency matters before the NCLT
Debt-recovery and SARFAESI appeals before the DRT and DRAT
Armed-forces service and disciplinary matters before the AFT
Interim relief and appeals from tribunal orders

education-matters.name: Education Matters
education-matters.summary: Disputes involving schools, colleges, universities and their staff.
education-matters.description: Educational institutions run on a dense web of statutes, regulations and approvals. We handle disputes involving schools, colleges, universities and their managing bodies — appointment and approval of teaching and non-teaching staff, admissions, recognition and affiliation, and other educational service matters.
bullets: Appointment and approval of teaching and non-teaching staff
Service, pay and disciplinary matters of institutional employees
Admission disputes and eligibility questions
Recognition, affiliation and institutional compliance
Managing-committee disputes and representation before the High Court

contempt-compliance-matters.name: Contempt & Compliance Matters
contempt-compliance-matters.summary: Making sure a favourable order is actually implemented.
contempt-compliance-matters.description: An order in your favour is only worth what is done about it. Where an authority or party fails to comply, we press for implementation and, where necessary, move contempt proceedings — and we defend those facing an allegation of contempt.
bullets: Contempt petitions for non-compliance with judicial orders
Enforcement and implementation of court directions
Representations and follow-up with the authority concerned
Defence in civil and criminal contempt proceedings
Advice on compliance obligations after an order

corporate-commercial-law.name: Corporate & Commercial Law
corporate-commercial-law.summary: Advisory and disputes for businesses, promoters and investors.
corporate-commercial-law.description: We support businesses across their commercial life — contracts, joint ventures, shareholder arrangements and commercial disputes — with advice that is practical, protective and alert to how disputes actually unfold.
bullets: Commercial contracts, joint ventures and shareholder agreements
Advisory on commercial transactions and structuring
Commercial and contractual dispute resolution
Promoter and investor dispute strategy
Notices, demands and pre-litigation negotiation

company-law.name: Company Law
company-law.description: We advise companies and directors on incorporation, governance, compliance and company-law disputes, and represent them in oppression, mismanagement and related matters before the NCLT.
bullets: Incorporation, governance and compliance advisory
Director and shareholder rights and duties
Oppression and mismanagement petitions before the NCLT
Statutory notices and regulatory responses
Restructuring and winding-up guidance

banking-finance-law.name: Banking & Finance Law
banking-finance-law.summary: Advisory and disputes for borrowers, guarantors and lenders.
banking-finance-law.description: We act for borrowers, guarantors and lenders in loan disputes, recovery proceedings and financial documentation, protecting your interests while keeping practical resolution in view.
bullets: Loan, guarantee and security documentation review
Defence in recovery and enforcement proceedings
One-time settlement and restructuring negotiation
Disputes over charges, interest and account statements
Advisory on borrower and guarantor rights

sarfaesi-drt-matters.name: SARFAESI & DRT Matters
sarfaesi-drt-matters.summary: Defending borrowers and guarantors in recovery actions.
sarfaesi-drt-matters.description: When a lender invokes the SARFAESI Act or moves the DRT, timelines are short and stakes are high. We challenge possession and sale notices, file securitisation applications and appeals, and press for stay where the law allows.
bullets: Reply to Section 13(2) and Section 13(4) notices
Securitisation applications before the DRT
Challenge to symbolic and physical possession
Appeals before the DRAT with pre-deposit guidance
Stay and injunction against auction of secured assets

cyber-law.name: Cyber Law
cyber-law.summary: Advice and remedies for online fraud, defamation and data misuse.
cyber-law.description: We advise individuals and businesses on cyber fraud, online defamation, data misuse and IT Act matters — helping you file complaints, seek takedowns and pursue civil and criminal remedies.
bullets: Complaints for online fraud and financial cybercrime
Online defamation and content takedown remedies
Data-misuse and privacy grievances
IT Act offences — advice and defence
Coordination with cyber cells and platforms

intellectual-property-rights.name: Intellectual Property Rights (IPR)
intellectual-property-rights.summary: Protecting trademarks, copyright and designs — and enforcing them.
intellectual-property-rights.description: Your brand and creative work are valuable assets. We handle trademark, copyright and design protection — searches, applications, objections and oppositions — and act firmly against infringement and passing off.
bullets: Trademark search, filing and prosecution
Copyright and design registration
Reply to objections and opposition proceedings
Infringement and passing-off action
Licensing, assignment and IP advisory

tax-revenue-matters.name: Tax & Revenue Matters
tax-revenue-matters.summary: Assessments, demands, refunds and penalties challenged before the right forum.
tax-revenue-matters.description: Tax and revenue disputes turn on limitation, procedure and the record. We advise on assessment and demand notices, pursue refunds and registration issues, contest penalty and revenue proceedings, and carry matters through statutory appeals and revisions.
bullets: Assessment, demand and recovery notice challenges
Refund claims and registration disputes
Penalty and interest proceedings
Revenue proceedings before statutory authorities
Statutory appeals and revisions before appellate forums

property-real-estate-law.name: Property & Real Estate Law
property-real-estate-law.summary: Title, possession, tenancy and real-estate disputes resolved.
property-real-estate-law.description: Property matters often put a family's most valuable asset at stake. We handle title verification, partition, possession and tenancy matters, boundary disputes and real-estate documentation — pairing litigation with practical settlement.
bullets: Title search and due diligence before purchase
Partition suits among family and co-owners
Possession, eviction and tenancy proceedings
Injunctions against illegal construction or dispossession
Sale deed, gift deed and agreement drafting and registration

land-acquisition-matters.name: Land Acquisition Matters
land-acquisition-matters.summary: Fair compensation and challenges to acquisition proceedings.
land-acquisition-matters.description: When land is acquired by the State, the process and compensation are often open to challenge. We advise landowners on acquisition proceedings, pursue enhanced compensation and question procedural lapses before the reference court and High Court.
bullets: Advice on acquisition notices and proceedings
Claims for enhanced compensation
Reference applications to the reference court
Challenge to procedural lapses and lapsing of acquisition
Representation before the High Court where required

service-employment-law.name: Service & Employment Law
service-employment-law.summary: For employees and employers — termination, dues and service matters.
service-employment-law.description: We advise employees on wrongful termination, unpaid dues, gratuity and service conditions, and represent employers in inquiries, labour proceedings and compliance matters — with the CAT and labour forums where relevant.
bullets: Wrongful termination and reinstatement claims
Recovery of salary, gratuity and PF dues
Service matters before the CAT and tribunals
Domestic inquiry and disciplinary-action support
Employment contract and policy drafting

trust-society-registration.name: Trust & Society Registration
trust-society-registration.summary: Setting up and running trusts and societies correctly.
trust-society-registration.description: We help set up trusts and societies with sound governing documents, complete their registration, and advise on compliance — so your charitable or member organisation stands on firm legal footing.
bullets: Drafting of trust deeds and society by-laws
Registration of trusts and societies
Governance and compliance advisory
Amendments, changes and dispute resolution
Guidance on statutory obligations and record-keeping

probate-succession-will.name: Probate, Succession & Will Matters
probate-succession-will.summary: Wills, probate, succession certificates and estate disputes.
probate-succession-will.description: We draft wills, obtain probate and letters of administration, secure succession and legal-heir certificates, and represent clients in inheritance and estate disputes — handling sensitive matters with care.
bullets: Drafting and safe custody of wills
Probate and letters of administration
Succession and legal-heir certificates
Inheritance and estate dispute litigation
Advice on devolution under applicable succession law

contract-drafting-legal-opinions.name: Contract Drafting & Legal Opinions
contract-drafting-legal-opinions.summary: Clear contracts and considered opinions that prevent disputes.
contract-drafting-legal-opinions.description: A well-drafted contract prevents tomorrow's dispute. We draft and review agreements across contexts and provide reasoned legal opinions on title, transactions and risk — in plain, precise language.
bullets: Drafting and review of commercial and personal agreements
Title and transaction opinions
Risk assessment and clause-level advice
Notices, undertakings and settlement documents
Plain-language explanation of your obligations

documentation-registration.name: Documentation & Registration
documentation-registration.summary: Deeds drafted and registered correctly, the first time.
documentation-registration.description: We prepare and register sale deeds, gift deeds, lease and rent agreements, powers of attorney and other instruments — ensuring correct stamping, valuation and registration so your documents hold up.
bullets: Sale, gift and lease deed drafting
Power of attorney and affidavit preparation
Correct stamp duty and valuation guidance
Registration before the Sub-Registrar
Verification of executed documents

municipal-local-authority-matters.name: Municipal & Local Authority Matters
municipal-local-authority-matters.summary: Building permissions, demolition notices, municipal tax and licences.
municipal-local-authority-matters.description: Local authorities can stop a project or tax a property on a single notice. We contest building-permission refusals, demolition and stop-work notices, municipal assessment and taxation, and licence and permission disputes — before the authority itself and, where needed, the High Court.
bullets: Building sanction, permission and deviation disputes
Demolition, eviction and stop-work notices
Municipal taxation and property assessment challenges
Trade licences, permissions and renewals
Writ petitions against arbitrary local-authority action
